integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. <Subject 1>'s weathered face is lit by his lantern as he looks up the iron spiral stairs of the lighthouse; then he turns and climbs them while a thunderstorm rolling in from the sea batters the tower. The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. The shot ends as <Subject 1> reaches the top of the lighthouse and looks out over the sea for boats.

overall_soundscape: Boots ring on iron steps and wind howls against the walls.

non_diegetic_music: A low, sustained cello drone at a slow tempo.
picks: {a rising gale|a heavy sea fog|a thunderstorm rolling in from the sea}
